FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.

2. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.

3. “Bonjour” is used to say: (1 mark)
   A. Good night only
   B. Good morning / hello
   C. Excuse me
   D. Thank you

4. When practising Reading for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Comprehension.

5. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.

6. When practising Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Comprehension.

7. When practising Grammar, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Grammar.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Grammar.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar.

8. The French word for “book” is: (1 mark)
   A. chaise
   B. livre
   C. fenêtre
   D. porte

9. When practising Reading for Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Vocabulary.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Vocabulary.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Vocabulary.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Vocabulary.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Guided writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
